svg.aria-label: AgentRQ isolated workspaces: api, web and docs each have their own MCP server and token, folder, tasks, memory and settings. claude, codex and agy connect with their own workspace's token and take only its tasks; codex saves a memory and it lands in web alone, and codex sees web and nothing else. agy asks to push in docs and you allow it there, then all six tasks are done and the agents celebrate.
